description.en: Creates a named 2D "telop" (an on-screen text/caption overlay, e.g. a technique-name banner), from a font size, base position and text.
Internal name to register the telop under.
True once it succeeded; false if the telop system isn't ready/found; null if the call itself was invalid (too few arguments).

example.code:
// Create a named telop caption for a technique name
CMND_2DO_CREATE_TELOP("\x008bZ\x0090\x00ea\x0097p\x0096\x00bc", 0, 12, 0, fn, wh, 6);
